error: The answer to R02 says the first revision of an order is kept; the spec and the clean stage keep the last.
issue_texts: CLAIM-DEDUP-RULE-MISSTATED | CLAIM-02.CLM-ORDERS.dedup_rule | gate_claims_auditor|dedup_rule|analysis/answers/R02.json|CLM-ORDERS | CLAIM_SUPPORT | CRITICAL | worker_analysis | analysis/answers/R02.json caveats state that the first revision is kept and that this is audit_spec.yaml dedup_rule. audit_spec.yaml dedup_rule is latest_revision_wins; check_plan raw_latest keep is last. Independent recomp
warning_texts: analysis/answers/R02.json is outside caveats_declared, so gate_claims_machine could not see the misstated revision rule.
CLM-ORDERS register caveats name one row after deduplication and exclusion of negative refunds, but they do not name that the last revision wins.
CLM-AOV-DIRECT and CLM-AOV-PARTNER caveats do not say net of refunds in words; the population field says delivered, and the figure is the mean of net_amount on delivered rows.
CLM-TEST-CHANNEL-AOV population text does not name the delivered-only filter that its n_per_group and the analysis plan assume.
shipping_total remains excused by name and is not a published claim; R05 names that excuse.
summary: R02 misstates the frozen dedup rule as first-revision-kept and cites audit_spec.yaml for that. Spec and check_plan keep the last row per order_id. Independent quarantine recompute matches every published point, interval, and test under last-revision-wins; first-revision net revenue is 3010704.83, not the published 3023296.61.
